scope_framing: Open a small audio-feedback bug thread for the user report: game sounds are not audible.
This is a technical diagnosis/build-planning problem, not a wave/design problem.
The next owner must map the existing audio path and propose the smallest reversible fix before build approval.
validated_facts: index.html declares audio tags for bgm, gameover-sfx, shot-sfx, bounce-sfx, onion-death-sfx, and levelup-sfx.
Referenced sounds/soundtrack.mp3, sounds/gameover.mp3, sounds/pi.shot.mp3, sounds/bullet.bounce.mp3, sounds/onion.death.mp3, and sounds/levelup.mp3 exist and are non-empty.
js/ui/audio.js owns createAudioController and calls HTMLMediaElement.play() for BGM and SFX.
main.js passes DOM audio elements into createAudioController.
README.md says audio starts only after a user gesture.
js/loader.js versions audio URLs through existing asset versioning.
Wave model contracts remain unrelated and must not be reopened by this task.
draft_assumptions: The failure may be asset URL, cache/versioning, autoplay policy, lifecycle pause/resume, DOM wiring, or swallowed play() rejection.
A new audio system or new assets are not justified without browser evidence.
Manual browser validation is mandatory because static checks cannot prove audibility.
current_direction: Route to gameplay-programmer with status IMPACT_ANALYSIS_REQUESTED.
Ask for a codebase impact map, confirmed code facts, minimal implementation plan, allowed/forbidden files, validations, manual tests, risks, and deferred items.
Keep changes scoped to existing audio/loader/wiring paths unless investigation proves otherwise.
explicit_non_goals: No wave, arena, scoring, enemy, player, bullet, onion, CSS, asset, network, presence, or nickname changes.
No broad loader or lifecycle rewrite.
requested_output_from_next_owner: Inspect the real audio playback path in index.html, js/ui/audio.js, main.js, js/loader.js, and browser runtime behavior if needed.
Determine the minimal allowed impact surface and forbidden files for a build-agent patch.
Specify runtime changes, code to keep/remove, validations, manual browser audio tests, risks, and deferred items.
exit_condition_for_next_owner: gameplay-programmer returns status_proposal IMPACT_ANALYSIS_DONE with next_owner task-orchestrator, or BLOCKED with concrete missing evidence.

human_handoff_prompt.chat_guidance: Continue this chat; a new chat is optional only if context becomes too large.
human_handoff_prompt.prompt:
$gameplay-programmer .agents/threads/003-audio-not-playing/thread.md

- distinguere asset path/cache, autoplay policy, user gesture, lifecycle resume/pause, DOM wiring e play() rejection
- produrre impact map e piano patch minimo, senza implementare codice
